summaries.headline: Vaccine Study Published Despite CDC Block
bullets: A study on COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness, originally blocked by CDC, was published in JAMA Network Open, showing 55% effectiveness against hospitalizations and 50% reduction in urgent care visits.
